{{Top}}
{{Quote|You were ''at'' Galidraan&hellip;tell me, how did one mere man kill so many of your kind?''"<br />"''With his bare hands.|Darth Sidious and Darth Tyranus, speaking about Jango Fett|<ref name="OS3">[[Jango Fett: Open Seasons 3|''Jango Fett: Open Seasons'' 3]]</ref>}}
[[File:WookieeSmash-EotE.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A Wookiee defeats a stormtrooper in unarmed combat]]
'''Unarmed combat''', '''martial arts''', or '''hand-to-hand combat''' was a type of fighting employed in close quarters and in which no weapons were used. Most [[Species/Legends|species]] practiced this kind of combat, and a number of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species and cultures also developed it into different martial arts proper. A person who practiced martial arts was known as a [[Martial artist/Legends|martial artist]], and an expert was called a martial arts master.<ref name="Galaxy at War">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|There is no man who is my equal in hand-to-hand combat. Except perhaps, if the stories are true, a Jedi Knight.|[[Guri]]|<ref name="shadows" />}}
[[File:Force-enhanced_punch_FDCR.png|thumb|left|200px|A Nautolan knocks out a stormtrooper in full armor with a Force-enhanced punch.]]
The [[Echani (martial art)/Legends|Echani martial art]] was an unarmed combat discipline known to be taught to military [[Special forces/Legends|special forces]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] also supplemented their skills in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] with unarmed combat training.<ref name="TSL">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref> Furthermore, some [[The Force/Legends|Force]] organizations like the [[Followers of Palawa]] created their own martial art, the [[Teräs Käsi/Legends|Teräs Käsi]].<ref name="shadows">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref> The stout, [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]]-[[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]], also invented their own martial art called "[[Stava (skill)|Stava]]," which was named after the fierce [[Stava|carnivorous predator]] of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. In technologically advanced civilizations, the need to train [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] in hand-to-hand and melee combat was a result of research breakthroughs in [[Blaster/Legends|blaster-deflection]], such as the [[Personal energy shield/Legends|personal energy shields]].<ref name="KotOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> Warlike people such as the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] trained in a variety of fighting techniques, including unarmed combat;<ref name="TSL" /> they were known to develop shields which resisted physical attacks.
